description: DISTI Betriebsdashboard: aktueller Prozessstatus, Timeline und Kernwerte aus kontinuierlicher Process Analysis. Diagnosefeatures bleiben in Diagnose / Entwicklung. Keine automatische Steuerung.

panels.description: Letzter gespeicherter Prozesszustand im gewählten Zeitraum. In der Live-Ansicht stammt er aus dem letzten abgeschlossenen Analyse-Bucket.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, process_state AS "Prozessstatus" FROM process_analysis WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND detector_name = ${analysis_detector:sqlstring} AND algo_version = ${analysis_version:sqlstring} ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1;

panels.title: Aktueller Prozessstatus

panels.description: Experimentelle Validierung; keine automatische Schnittentscheidung. Nachlauf-Score ist keine statistische Wahrscheinlichkeit.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, process_state AS "Prozessstatus" FROM process_analysis WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND detector_name = ${analysis_detector:sqlstring} AND algo_version = ${analysis_version:sqlstring} ORDER BY time;

panels.title: Prozessstatus

panels.description: Kernwerte des letzten abgeschlossenen Analyse-Buckets. Nachlauf-Score ist ein technischer Score, keine statistische Wahrscheinlichkeit; 50 entspricht S=h.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, vapor_temp AS "Kesseldampf", dtdt AS "dT/dt", raw_mv AS "EC raw (mV)", 50 * detector_score AS "Nachlauf-Score", detector_alarm::int AS "Nachlauf-Alarm" FROM process_analysis WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND detector_name = ${analysis_detector:sqlstring} AND algo_version = ${analysis_version:sqlstring} ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1;

panels.title: Temperatur – Prozessanalyse

panels.description: Gespeichertes EC-Prozesssignal des abgeschlossenen Analyse-Buckets; Diagnosefeatures in Diagnose / Entwicklung.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, raw_mv AS "EC raw (mV)" FROM process_analysis WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND detector_name = ${analysis_detector:sqlstring} AND algo_version = ${analysis_version:sqlstring} ORDER BY time;

panels.title: EC Prozesssignal

panels.description: Nachlauf-Score = 50 × detector_score: 25 = halbe Schwelle, 50 = S/h 1, 75 = S/h 1,5, 100 = S/h ≥2. Technischer Score, keine statistische Wahrscheinlichkeit; keine automatische Schnittentscheidung.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, 50 * detector_score AS "Nachlauf-Score", detector_alarm::int AS "Alarm" FROM process_analysis WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND detector_name = ${analysis_detector:sqlstring} AND algo_version = ${analysis_version:sqlstring} ORDER BY time;

panels.title: Nachlauf-Detector

panels.description: Temperaturdynamische Vorlauf-Erkennung: vorher dT/dt ≥1,0 °C/min; VORLAUF bei dT/dt ≤0,30 für 40 s. VORLAUF_AUSKLANG bei stabilem 120-s-Fenster: Median |dT/dt| ≤0,12 und mindestens 80 % der Werte |dT/dt| ≤0,20. MITTELLAUF nach weiteren 90 s Bestätigung. EC, Trends und Recovery sind nur diagnostisch; keine feste Vorlauf-Temperaturgrenze.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, vapor_temp AS "Kesseldampf (°C)", raw_mv AS "EC raw (mV)", ec_plateau_ref AS "EC Plateau-Referenz (mV)", ec_min_since_plateau AS "EC Minimum seit Plateau (mV)", ec_drop_from_plateau AS "EC-Abfall vom Plateau (mV)", ec_recovery_from_min AS "EC-Erholung vom Minimum (mV)", dtdt AS "dT/dt (°C/min)", rise_from_min_5m AS "Anstieg vom Minimum (mV)", trend_1m AS "Trend 1 min (mV/min)", trend_3m AS "Trend 3 min (mV/min)", trend_5m AS "Trend 5 min (mV/min)", trend_accel_3m AS "Trendänderung 3 min (mV/min²)", trend_accel_5m AS "Trendänderung 5 min (mV/min²)" FROM process_analysis WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND detector_name = ${analysis_detector:sqlstring} AND algo_version = ${analysis_version:sqlstring} ORDER BY time;

panels.title: Vergleichsmarker

panels.description: Experimentelle Validierung; keine automatische Schnittentscheidung. Nachlauf-Score ist keine statistische Wahrscheinlichkeit.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, raw_mv AS "EC raw (mV)", raw_mv_1m AS "EC 1 min (mV)", raw_mv_5m AS "EC 5 min (mV)", CASE WHEN detector_name='cusum' THEN (details->>'baseline_mu')::double precision END AS "CUSUM Baseline (mV)" FROM process_analysis WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND detector_name = ${analysis_detector:sqlstring} AND algo_version = ${analysis_version:sqlstring} ORDER BY time;

panels.title: EC Glättung / Baseline

panels.description: Nachlauf-Score = 50 × detector_score: 25 = halbe Schwelle, 50 = S/h 1, 75 = S/h 1,5, 100 = S/h ≥2. Technischer Score, keine statistische Wahrscheinlichkeit; keine automatische Schnittentscheidung.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, 50 * detector_score AS "Nachlauf-Score", detector_alarm::int AS "Alarm", (details->>'cusum_s')::double precision AS "CUSUM S", (details->>'z')::double precision AS "z", (details->>'baseline_mu')::double precision AS "Baseline μ (mV)", (details->>'baseline_sigma')::double precision AS "Baseline σ (mV)" FROM process_analysis WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND detector_name = ${analysis_detector:sqlstring} AND algo_version = ${analysis_version:sqlstring} ORDER BY time;

panels.title: CUSUM Diagnose

panels.description: Aktuellster Messwert im gewählten Zeitraum. Die übernommenen Temperaturschwellen 70/80/90 °C dienen ausschließlich als visuelle Orientierung und stellen keine Vorlauf-/Mittellauf-/Nachlauf-Erkennung dar.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, value AS "Kesseldampf"
FROM sensor_measurements
WHERE sensor_id = 'vapor-temp'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1;

panels.title: Kesseldampf

panels.description: Aktuellste kalibrierte Leitfähigkeit und zugehörige EC-Temperatur im gewählten Zeitraum. Für EC werden bewusst keine Gut-/Schlecht-Bereiche definiert.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, value AS "EC"
FROM sensor_measurements
WHERE sensor_id = 'ec-1'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT time, value AS "EC-Temperatur"
FROM sensor_measurements
WHERE sensor_id = 'ec-temp'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1;

panels.title: EC

panels.description: Kalibrierte Kesseldampftemperatur, dynamisch nach dem Grafana-Zeitintervall aggregiert.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS "time",
       avg(value)::double precision AS "Kesseldampf"
FROM sensor_measurements
WHERE sensor_id = 'vapor-temp'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Kesseldampf – Prozessverlauf

panels.description: Kalibrierte EC-Leitfähigkeit, dynamisch nach dem Grafana-Zeitintervall aggregiert.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS "time",
       avg(value)::double precision AS "EC"
FROM sensor_measurements
WHERE sensor_id = 'ec-1'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: EC – Verlauf

panels.description: Je Intervall wird der tatsächlich zuletzt gespeicherte raw_mv-Messwert dargestellt; die Aggregation reduziert nur die Visualisierungsdichte und verändert keine gespeicherten Messungen.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS "time",
       last(raw_mv, time)::double precision AS value,
       CASE sensor_id
         WHEN 'ec-1' THEN 'EC raw_mv'
         WHEN 'ec-temp' THEN 'EC-Temperatur / PT1000 raw_mv'
       END AS metric
FROM sensor_measurements
WHERE sensor_id IN ('ec-1', 'ec-temp')
  AND raw_mv IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1, sensor_id
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Analog-Rohwerte

panels.description: Neuester gespeicherter Datensatz je Sensor, unabhängig vom Dashboard-Zeitfenster, damit auch ausgefallene bzw. alte Sensoren sichtbar bleiben.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sensor_id AS "Sensor",
       value AS "Wert",
       raw_value AS "Rohwert",
       raw_mv AS "Rohspannung (mV)",
       unit AS "Einheit",
       quality AS "Qualität",
       time AS "Zeitpunkt",
       EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - time))::double precision AS "Alter"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (sensor_id)
         sensor_id, value, raw_value, raw_mv, unit, quality, time
  FROM sensor_measurements
  WHERE sensor_id IN ('vapor-temp', 'cooler-temp', 'ec-1', 'ec-temp')
  ORDER BY sensor_id, time DESC
) AS latest
ORDER BY sensor_id;
